main.description: The plans a new or changed instance can use. Customers only.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not a HappyProto customer, or the provisioner refused them.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The provisioner refused the request as malformed. Not expected from this read; declared because every provisioner refusal is mapped the same way.

errors.name: AccountSuspended
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner: staff have suspended the account.

errors.name: PlanNotOffered
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner: owners may not pick that plan themselves; it is available on request.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: The provisioner is unreachable, not configured, or answered with an error it does not explain to callers.

tier.description: The priced tier the plan is. Absent for a plan without a price.

priceCents.description: The monthly price, in the smallest unit of currency, before tax.

includedLiveRecords.description: Live records delivered a month that the price includes.

includedBackfillRecords.description: Backfill records delivered a month that the price includes.

seats.description: The HappyView admins an instance on the plan may have.

logRetentionDays.description: How many days of logs an instance on the plan keeps.

hookWorkers.description: Hooks an instance on the plan runs at once.

jobWorkers.description: Jobs an instance on the plan runs at once.
